Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - S.C.C. No. 903/2020

Dear Ms. Kapoor,

Thank you for meeting us on 28 December 2020 about your dispute with Revathi Saxena. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹31,90,000.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
